column1: # English initialism lexicon for DemaConsulting.Speech.Text.En (embedded resource).
# Written from scratch by DEMA Consulting and released under the MIT license of this package.
# No third-party acronym list was copied.
# Format: UTF-8, LF, tab-separated. Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
# The first remaining line is the header. Columns:
#   form       the all-capital token exactly as written, case-sensitive
#   spoken     the letters spoken one by one, separated by single spaces
#   ambiguous  yes when the form is also an ordinary English word written in capitals
#              (it is then left alone inside an all-capital sentence)
# Acronyms spoken as words (NASA, NATO) are deliberately not listed. The initialisms that the pronunciation
# dictionary has as a word or a name (KIA as the car brand, MIA and IRA as names, POW and GED as words, AKA read as a
# word) are listed so the dictionary's word is not read for them; the casualty and status initialisms (KIA, MIA, WIA, POW,
# DOA) and the common ones with a vowel that the dictionary lacks (ETA, ICU, IED, EOD) are listed with them.
